messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not take to lose weight"
set: ["do not take to lose weight", "do not take more than recommended", "do not take an extra dose", "do not take more than prescribed", "dose needs may change if you gain or lose weight", "do not take more than recommended dose", "do not take two doses at once", "do not take an extra dose to treat exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "do not take more medicine without talking to healthcare provider", "do not take more or less than prescribed", "do not take more than your prescribed dose", "do not take after 30 weeks of pregnancy", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to", "do not take extra doses between scheduled doses", "do not take two doses at one time", "do not breastfeed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
